name: Jetpack
author: Sixth Front
description: Hold J (or the JETPACK button) to fly. Fuel refills while you stand on the ground, and landings after a flight don't hurt.
script: // Hooks used: bindKey with press and release, on('tick'), setVelocity, effect, hud.bar, filter('damage')
let fuel = MAX_FUEL, burning = false, lastBurn = -99;
if (!P || P.state !== 'alive' || P.vehicle || api.state() !== 'playing') { api.hud.remove('fuel'); return; }
api.setVelocity(P, P.vel.x + f.x * 7 * dt, Math.min(P.vel.y + 36 * dt, 9), P.vel.z + f.z * 7 * dt);
if (Math.random() < 0.7) api.effect('fire', P.pos.x, P.pos.y + 0.5, P.pos.z, { size: 0.3 });
if (Math.random() < 0.25) api.effect('smoke', P.pos.x, P.pos.y + 0.3, P.pos.z, { size: 0.3 });
api.hud.bar('fuel', fuel / MAX_FUEL, { label: on ? 'JETPACK · BURNING' : 'JETPACK [J]', x: 42, y: 82, color: fuel < 0.8 ? '#ff4b3a' : '#f2b33d' });
// No fall damage for a few seconds after flying
if (d.victim.isPlayer && d.info.weapon === 'FALL' && api.time() - lastBurn < 6) return false;
